name: creative-writing-skills
description: Composable subagents and skills for creative writing projects. Run /cw-project-setup once per book, then activate /cw-muse as your creative partner to brainstorm, draft, critique, and maintain your story's knowledge base.
author: Jimmy Yao
suggestedPrompts: Run /cw-project-setup to initialize a new book project in this workspace
Activate /cw-muse to brainstorm and outline my story premise
Activate /cw-muse to draft or critique the next chapter using my kb/ style and canon
